shared_elements: single dominant figure filling a tall vertical field
elaborate patterned costume/garment rendered with dense incised detail
low-relief carving on a slab-like upright surface
justification: Both depict a single standing human figure in low relief occupying nearly the whole of a tall rectangular field, with an elaborately detailed costume and a raised arm — a generic and widely independent scheme. They differ in almost every specific: B shows a clean profile head with long stylised beard, wings and long trailing garment with fine linear pleating, while A shows a frontal-bodied figure with a massive block-like headdress, glyph-like panels above and below, and dense compartmentalised ornament rather than flowing linear drapery.
